feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 June 2026 5:29pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 15 June 2026 at 5:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A fairly stagnant area of low pressure in the North Atlantic deepening slightly and bringing a series of fronts across the area.


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 or 4, gradually veering south or southwest 3 or 4 overnight and for tomorrow morning, occasionally 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Patchy rain at this evening at first tonight, then the risk of mist or fog patches developing overnight. Further outbreaks of rain later tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in mist and very poor in fog patches developing overnight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain as well as areas of mist and isolated fog patches becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, falling very poor in fog patches.
